/privacy-policy.title: Crays Privacy Policy | Be Long Here

children: This Agreement is between you and Crays AG, Schindellegistrasse 73, CH-8808 Pfäffikon, Switzerland. CEO: Kai Thorben Biesenbach. This policy pertains to your use of Crays applications and services, including but not limited to the Crays web app, Crays iOS app, Crays Android app, Crays browser extension, Crays Premium Service, Crays Hosted Wallet Service, Crays Award, voting, nomination, partner and event communication services (collectively referred to as "Services").

Crays does not monetize personal information. We do not generate revenue via advertising, do not monetize user attention, and do not sell personal information collected from users. Crays aims to maximize user privacy by collecting only the minimum information required to provide quality services and to comply with applicable laws.

Crays enables account creation on the public Nostr network. Information provided during account creation is optional, except for the desired username. Information disclosed in this process is published to public Nostr relays and can be viewed by anyone on the network.

Crays does not collect data via Crays mobile apps beyond the data you explicitly submit for publishing on the public Nostr network and, where applicable, data required for optional Hosted Wallet activation.

Crays Premium Service is an optional subscription tier that includes Crays Orange Check and additional premium features. The service is designed for maximum privacy and does not require disclosing personal information beyond what is necessary for service operation.

Hosted Wallet Service is optional and includes custody of small bitcoin balances, send/receive operations, transaction history, and a hosted Lightning Address. To activate the service in compliance with law, Crays collects only the minimum information required.
Crays provides support via email and social channels. Information provided in communications may be stored in support systems and communication platforms for service and compliance purposes.
Personal information is used to deliver services, provide support, maintain account operations, and communicate with users as needed.

Crays does not share personal information with third parties except when legally required. Information may be shared with authorities where required by subpoena, court order, legal process, fraud prevention, legal investigations, or enforcement of terms.
Crays Hosted Wallet Service is offered in partnership with Breez, Inc. In order to provide a compliant hosted wallet service, wallet-related data may be shared with Breez.
You may access and update account information, and where available, request account deactivation and data deletion in accordance with legal and operational requirements.
Crays applies robust security measures based on industry best practices to protect confidentiality, integrity, and availability of personal information. No system can guarantee absolute security.
Crays may update this policy over time. Updates are communicated by revising the date above and, where appropriate, by additional notices.

/data-protection.title: Crays Data Protection | Be Long Here

children: This Data Protection Notice is issued by Crays AG, Schindellegistrasse 73, CH-8808 Pfäffikon, Switzerland. CEO: Kai Thorben Biesenbach.

This Data Protection Notice aligns with the Crays Privacy Policy and applies to the Crays web app, iOS app, Android app, browser extension, premium offerings, hosted wallet services, award, voting, nomination, partner and event communication services.

Crays applies purpose limitation, data minimization, and privacy-by-design principles. Personal data is processed only when required for service delivery, user support, legal compliance, or security operations.

Data is processed for specific and transparent purposes. Public profile details shared to the Nostr network are user-submitted and publicly visible by design. Wallet, award, voting, nomination, contact and support data are handled under service and compliance requirements.

Crays uses technical and organizational safeguards to protect confidentiality, integrity, and availability of personal information. Data is retained no longer than necessary for legal obligations, service needs, or dispute resolution.
Crays does not sell personal information. Data is shared only where legally required or where needed for service delivery, such as hosted wallet operations with authorized partners.
Users can request information access, corrections, and where applicable, deletion or deactivation. Requests are handled in line with legal and operational constraints.
